title: Brutal Drinks Blackcurrant Crush 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Brutal Drinks’ Blackcurrant Crush Shortfill e-liquid offers the rich and juicy taste of fresh Blackcurrant, bursting with natural sweetness and deep berry notes. This vibrant flavour is perfect for vapers who love bold and fruity e-liquids. Crafted by Just Juice, Brutal Drinks Shortfills deliver intense flavours in a high-VG format, designed for sub-ohm devices and advanced kits. Blackcurrant Crush comes in a 100ml bottle, leaving space for two nicotine shots to give you the flexibility to adjust your nicotine strength. Part of the Brutal Drinks collection, Blackcurrant Crush joins a line-up of bold drink-inspired blends, including Mango Lassi, Frozen Mojito, and Brutal Bull. Explore the full range for more refreshing and flavourful options.
